claims.claim: PostHog's public project-token runtime API accepts event capture and remote feature-flag evaluation.
claims.summary: The fixed first-party capture and feature-flag documentation describes public project-token requests for capturing events and evaluating feature flags.

claims.claim: Capture requests can write event, person, or group data.
claims.summary: The capture documentation describes event capture properties that can set person and group properties in addition to recording events.

claims.claim: Remote feature-flag evaluation can affect PostHog usage quota.
claims.summary: The fixed feature-flags API documentation explains the remote evaluation endpoint and its response includes quota-limiting state; the PostHog pricing page describes feature-flag requests as usage-based.
